name: jev-triage
description: Narrow a large candidate set to the few that matter before they enter the model's context, using TypeSafe/Jev for the typed judgment. Zero dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the haystack out of context: narrow candidates with Jev before they cost tokens
interface.longDescription: Narrow a large candidate set to the few that matter before they enter the model's context, using TypeSafe/Jev for the typed judgment. Zero dependencies. Requires a TypeSafe API key; run scripts/preflight.mjs to check. Includes a break-even gate that refuses to narrow when doing so would cost more than it saves.
